lessons_used: Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.

Choose path redesign changes can be helpful (1 test won), though 3 tests showed no clear effect; evidence is still thin for single-test categories (finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in reorder).

Positive predictions were generally too high (with a few exceptions), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Narrative Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the story screen using a split layout that presents the pet backstory alongside path option highlights.
candidates.why: Choose path has an 87.2% conversion rate and high mean time (514s), showing users need clearer initial context.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose how you want your pet to live on your desktop and interact with your daily tasks.

guard.reason: Story screen redesign retains pet introduction and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drops only 12.8%; redesigns here showed moderate success (+1.9% average across 4 tests).

candidates.title: Sign In Account Restoration Clarification
candidates.change: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that signing into an existing account restores previous pets and data.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after users signed in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account will safely restore your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Sign-in account restoration hint provides clear information without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27.1% and 8 support emails confirm user confusion. Config-only hint is cheap but lift is historically low (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a two column layout comparing pet personalities side by side.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89s / mean 1017s.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Starting Companion
pick_friend.body: Compare companion traits and choose the pet that fits your workflow best.

guard.reason: Two-column redesign preserves pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 39.1%, but adoption redesigns consistently failed (-2.4% average, 1 test stopped early).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Status Readiness Tip
candidates.change: Add desktop preparation tips and an optional completion notification switch to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home stage wait averages 201s median / 2336s mean, leading to drop-offs and support questions.

waiting.hint: Your pet is getting ready! Ensure your desktop background allows app overlays.

guard.reason: Adding preparation tips and progress notifications to waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step wait time is long (2336s mean) with support questions; minor UI additions on home showed mild promise (+1.6%).

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Guidance Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before home completion providing clear instructions on where the mascot appears on desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop and 3 emails confused about controls after setup.

new_desktop_placement_guide.headline: Locating Your Desktop Pet
new_desktop_placement_guide.body: Your pet will appear in the bottom right corner of your screen. Look for the tray icon to toggle visibility.

guard.reason: Adding a placement guidance screen before home intro inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 35.2% and 6 support emails support this, but adding new screens has proven ineffective (+0.4% across 3 tests) and costs a release.

candidates.title: Choose Path Explicit Mode Descriptions
candidates.change: Update headline and body copy on choose path screen to explicitly contrast quick companion vs custom pet modes.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration of 514s indicates confusion between available paths.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Wish to Start
choose_path.body: Pick a quick starter pet instantly or spend a moment creating a custom pet tailored to you.

guard.reason: Updated copy maintains both path options (adopting and creating).

candidates.score_note: Copy tweak on choose path is config-only (low cost), but targeted step drop-off is relatively small (12.8%).

candidates.title: Sign In Connection Troubleshooting Hint
candidates.change: Add connection assistance copy and troubleshooting hint directly on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: Support received emails where the sign-in screen stalled or failed to render properly.

sign_in.hint: Having trouble signing in? Click here for quick offline setup options or connection help.

guard.reason: Suggests getting around the mandatory sign-in step.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Quality Checklist Hint
candidates.change: Add lighting and image format quality guidelines to the photo upload screen hint.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpected visual results.

upload_photos.hint: For best generation results, upload well-lit photos with a clear subject and clean background.

guard.reason: Asks for photos, which can contain personal information about the user.

candidates.title: Home Intro Card Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home intro into a card layout displaying quick control shortcuts (hide, summon, speak).
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide, control, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access settings.

guard.reason: Redesigning home intro card inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2% and 3 support emails confirm post-onboarding confusion; however, finish redesigns historically measured -1.0%.

candidates.title: Story Mode Selection Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated mode overview screen right after story introducing path capabilities.
candidates.why: Adding context early helps address path selection hesitation and improves funnel flow into sign-in.

new_mode_overview.headline: Understanding Your Playstyle
new_mode_overview.body: Whether you want a low-maintenance desk buddy or a fully custom avatar, we have a path for you.

guard.reason: Inserting a mode overview screen after story retains all required steps and complies with rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens shows no clear positive effect across multiple categories, and requires a full release.

picked: Pick Friend Two Column Selection Redesign

decisions.title: Pick Friend Two Column Selection Redesign

lessons_next: Choose path redesign changes can be helpful (1 test won), though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse performance.
Adoption new screen and sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in reorder).
Positive predictions were generally too high, while negative predictions were generally too pessimistic.
